title: US Midterms: Democrat Sweep Hits Stocks, Nasdaq Futures and Dollar Fall
summary: Gotrade News - US stock index futures tumbled and the dollar fell after Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in Tuesday's midterm elections,
body_markdown:
> "The significance of these midterm elections is more like a referendum on AI than a referendum on Trump."
>
>
> Aidan Yao, senior investment strategist for Asia, Amundi Investment Institute (via Reuters)


## Texas Senate Win Puts AI Data Centers in Focus


Democrats won Senate races in South Carolina, Texas and Ohio, according to[Reuters](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/us-stock-futures-dip-investors-010842458.html) . Kim Seok-hwan, an analyst at Mirae Asset Securities, said the Democrats' victory in Texas is likely to weigh on chip stocks. "If Texas declares a moratorium on data centres, as New York did, projects could face further delays," he said.


In Asia, chipmakers Samsung, SK Hynix and TSMC slid sharply before cutting losses, Reuters reported.


## Dollar Hits One-Month Low as 10-Year Yield Falls to 4.906%


The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note fell 6 basis points to 4.906%, pushing the dollar sharply lower, according to[Reuters](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/us-stock-futures-dip-investors-010842458.html) . The dollar index fell 0.37% to 101.34, a one-month low, while the euro rose 0.5% to $1.1249.


## Futures Turn Higher by 3:13 a.m. ET as Dip Buyers Step In


Nasdaq futures skidded more than 2% before cutting losses to trade down 0.5%, and S&P 500 futures were last down 0.35% in an earlier Reuters reading. "Looks like investors are buying the dip after the initial knee-jerk selloff," Chanana said, as reported by[Reuters](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/us-stock-futures-dip-investors-010842458.html) .


By 3:13 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 237 points, or 0.46%, S&P 500 E-minis were up 11.25 points, or 0.15%, and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were up 72.75 points, or 0.26%, according to[Reuters](https://za.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-index-futures-steady-as-democrats-seize-congress-4548527) .
